content.title: Talking to seniors?
content.subtitle: Ask the right way, and you'll get real answers.

steps.title: The right platform
steps.detail: LinkedIn or the university's student groups. Check their course and city first.

steps.title: A short intro
steps.detail: Your name, your course and one line on why you're messaging.

steps.title: Specific questions
steps.detail: Don't ask them to tell you everything. Ask one or two things about rent, classes or the city.

steps.title: Respect their time
steps.detail: If the reply comes late, that's fine. Don't send message after message.

steps.title: Say thank you
steps.detail: Got a reply? Say thanks. Later, help a junior the same way.

caption:
Talking to seniors is the best research there is. Just do it the right way 👇

1. The right platform
2. A short intro
3. Specific questions
4. Respect their time
5. Say thank you
